title: knap initialization options
description: Configuration passed to the knap LSP server via initializationOptions.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference — used by editors for validation and autocompletion.

extensions.description: File extensions treated as notes. Files with other extensions are treated as attachments. Default: ["md"].

newNoteDir.description: Folder relative to the workspace root where Quick Fix 'Create note' actions create new files (e.g. "0-Inbox"). Defaults to the same directory as the current note.

skipDirs.description: Glob patterns matched against bare directory names, pruned from the crawl.

ignoreLinkTargets.description: Glob patterns matched against a link's raw target text, suppressing broken-link diagnostics.

frontmatterSchema.description: Defines allowed keys and values for a doc's frontmatter. Enables key/value completions and diagnostics.

requireFrontmatter.description: Warn on docs that have no '---' frontmatter block at all when required keys exist.

warnOnUnknownKeys.description: Warn on frontmatter keys not listed in 'fields'.

fields.description: Map of frontmatter key names to their constraints.

required.description: Warn when the key is absent from the doc's frontmatter.

values.description: Allowed values for this key (exact-case). Omit to allow any value.
